rationale: An AI-generated artefact MUST carry rationale and at least one reference so its provenance and authority basis are traceable.
stopConditions: The generated artefact conflicts with a higher-authority semantic definition or ADR.
title: AI-generated artefact with required references
description: Valid ai-governance artefact of kind ai-generated-artefact carrying a non-empty references array as required by the conditional rule.
